## Changes: ### Bugs: * #4208: Fix Gemini tool calling errors by stripping orphaned tool_calls without response ### Others: * #4224: Prompt update * #4222: Enhance CopilotCLIModels capabilities by adding toolCalling support * #4148: Update Copilot CLI tool mapping with new/updated tools from runtime * #4217: Update GitHub Copilot npm package to version 0.0.421 and adjust related SDK usage * #4221: dont defer the task complete tool * #4219: Exempt Search Subagent tool result from write to disk * #4198: Add 'launch' skill for Copilot Chat extension UI automation via agent-browser
See More * #4216: fix: update model capabilities * #4209: Add code review command * #4214: implement custom tool search functionality with embeddings-based query * #4177: feat: update agent ID handling in CopilotCLIAgents * #4205: Disable WebSocket connections after 3 consecutive failures * #4206: Bump @hono/node-server from 1.19.9 to 1.19.10 * #4055: support autopilot mode * #4202: Default to Windows Powershell 5.1 for hooks execution on windows * #4194: Clarify multi-root scoping for custom instructions This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=415916&view=logs).
